page.content:
2010 series that put Twilight Sparkle and the Mane Six in Equestria.

How My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic connects

  • Creator: Lauren Faust — Lauren Faust developed Friendship Is Magic and the Mane Six.
  • Faction: Mane Six — The Mane Six are the standing heroes of Friendship Is Magic.
  • Topic: My Little Pony — Friendship Is Magic is the flagship modern series of My Little Pony.
  • Character: Twilight Sparkle — Twilight Sparkle is the viewpoint pony of Friendship Is Magic.
  • Location: Equestria — Friendship Is Magic is set in Equestria.
  • Work: My Little Pony (G1) — The G1 toy era came before Friendship Is Magic remade the brand.
  • Work: My Little Pony: A New Generation — Friendship Is Magic is the series A New Generation follows.
  • Concept: Friendship magic — Friendship Is Magic treats friendship as a working kind of spell.
  • Work: My Little Pony: Equestria Girls — Equestria Girls spins the Mane Six into a human-world film series.

What is My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic?

Friendship Is Magic is Lauren Faust's series: Twilight Sparkle studies friendship in Ponyville, Princess Celestia rules from Canterlot, and the Mane Six wield the Elements of Harmony for nine seasons.

Key threads lead to Lauren Faust, Mane Six, My Little Pony, Twilight Sparkle, Equestria and My Little Pony (G1).
